faq.a: Lukman is associated with the Arabic form لُقْمَان, whose core sense is lukman; luqman (a wise man in the quran).

faq.q: What is the origin of Lukman?
faq.a: Lukman is associated with Arabic. Lukman is Arabic لُقْمَان (Luqmān), the name of a wise man mentioned in the Quran.
Yes — the underlying form لُقْمَان is Arabic.
Lukman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Lukman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Luqmān occurs in the Quran as the name of a wise man.

faq.q: What does Lukman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Lukman is rendered لقمان and carries the sense لقمان، قرآن میں حکیم.

faq.q: What does Lukman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Lukman is rendered لقمان and carries the sense لقمان، حکیم قرآنی.
A romanized syllable approximation is luk-man. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Lukman?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Lukman, lukman. Script forms are لقمان, لُقْمَان, लुक़मान.

faq.q: Is Lukman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
